CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_subscription_summary(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user RECORD;
    v_plan JSONB;
    v_payment_count INT;
BEGIN
    IF p_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_user_id is required';
    END IF;

    SELECT society, tower, block, unit_flat_number
    INTO v_user
    FROM "SSP_Society_User"
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id
    LIMIT 1;

    DECLARE
        v_sub RECORD;
        v_entitlements JSONB;
    BEGIN
        SELECT s.*, p.plan_code, p.plan_name
        INTO v_sub
        FROM "SSP_Subscription" s
        JOIN "SSP_Subscription_Plan" p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id
        WHERE s.society = v_user.society
          AND COALESCE(s.tower::text, '∅') = COALESCE(v_user.tower::text, '∅')
          AND COALESCE(s.block::text, '∅') = COALESCE(v_user.block::text, '∅')
          AND upper(trim(s.flat_number)) = upper(trim(v_user.unit_flat_number))
          AND s.status IN ('trial', 'active')                 -- ⭐ lowercase
          AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date > NOW())
        ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 1;

        SELECT jsonb_object_agg(f.feature_code, pf.enabled)
        INTO v_entitlements
        FROM "SSP_Plan_Feature" pf
        JOIN "SSP_Feature" f ON f.feature_id = pf.feature_id
        JOIN "SSP_Subscription_Plan" p ON p.plan_id = pf.plan_id
        WHERE p.plan_code = COALESCE(v_sub.plan_code, 'FREE')
          AND f.is_active = TRUE;

        v_plan := jsonb_build_object(
            'plan_code', COALESCE(v_sub.plan_code, 'FREE'),
            'plan_name', COALESCE(v_sub.plan_name, 'Free'),
            'status', COALESCE(v_sub.status, 'active'),      -- ⭐ lowercase
            'start_date', v_sub.start_date,
            'end_date', v_sub.end_date,
            'auto_renew', COALESCE(v_sub.auto_renew, FALSE),
            'entitlements', COALESCE(v_entitlements, '{}'::jsonb)
        );
    END;

    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_payment_count
    FROM "SSP_Payment"
    WHERE society_user = p_user_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'plan', v_plan,
        'flat', jsonb_build_object(
            'society', v_user.society,
            'tower', v_user.tower,
            'block', v_user.block,
            'flat_number', v_user.unit_flat_number
        ),
        'payment_count', v_payment_count
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_my_payments(p_user_id uuid, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_offset INT;
    v_limit INT;
    v_items JSONB;
    v_total INT;
BEGIN
    IF p_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_user_id is required';
    END IF;

    v_limit := LEAST(GREATEST(p_limit, 1), 100);
    v_offset := GREATEST((p_page - 1) * v_limit, 0);

    -- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- Total count — SUBSCRIPTION payments only
    -- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_total
    FROM "SSP_Payment"
    WHERE society_user = p_user_id
      AND upper(payment_type) = 'SUBSCRIPTION';

    -- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- Paged items — SUBSCRIPTION payments only
    -- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_items
    FROM (
        SELECT
            p.pay_rec_id,
            p.amount,
            p.payment_type,
            p.payment_status,
            p.payment_method,
            p.payment_id,
            p.payment_date,
            p.created_at,
            p.receipt_url,
            sp.provider_order_id,
            sp.provider_payment_id,
            sp.payment_purpose,
            sp.captured_at
        FROM "SSP_Payment" p
        LEFT JOIN "SSP_Subscription_Payment" sp ON sp.payment = p.pay_rec_id
        WHERE p.society_user = p_user_id
          AND upper(p.payment_type) = 'SUBSCRIPTION'
        ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
        LIMIT v_limit OFFSET v_offset
    ) t;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'items', v_items,
        'pagination', jsonb_build_object(
            'total', v_total,
            'page', p_page,
            'limit', v_limit,
            'total_pages', CEIL(v_total::numeric / v_limit)::int
        )
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_plans()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_result JSONB;
BEGIN
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'plan_id', p.plan_id,
            'plan_code', p.plan_code,
            'plan_name', p.plan_name,
            'description', p.description,
            'sort_order', p.sort_order,
            'features', (
                SELECT jsonb_object_agg(f.feature_code, pf.enabled)
                FROM "SSP_Plan_Feature" pf
                JOIN "SSP_Feature" f ON f.feature_id = pf.feature_id
                WHERE pf.plan_id = p.plan_id
                  AND f.is_active = TRUE
            ),
            'prices', (
                SELECT jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'plan_price_id', pp.plan_price_id,
                        'billing_period', pp.billing_period,
                        'amount', pp.amount,
                        'currency', pp.currency,
                        'validity_months', pp.validity_months,
                        'discount_percentage', pp.discount_percentage
                    )
                    ORDER BY
                        CASE pp.billing_period
                            WHEN 'MONTHLY' THEN 1
                            WHEN 'QUARTERLY' THEN 2
                            WHEN 'HALF_YEARLY' THEN 3
                            WHEN 'YEARLY' THEN 4
                            WHEN 'THREE_YEAR' THEN 5
                            ELSE 99
                        END
                )
                FROM "SSP_Subscription_Plan_Price" pp
                WHERE pp.plan_id = p.plan_id
                  AND pp.is_active = TRUE
            )
        )
        ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.plan_code
    )
    INTO v_result
    FROM "SSP_Subscription_Plan" p
    WHERE p.is_active = TRUE;

    RETURN COALESCE(v_result, '[]'::jsonb);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transfer_list(p_user_id uuid, p_filter text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_items JSONB;
    v_filter TEXT;
BEGIN
    IF p_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', FALSE, 'reason', 'User ID required');
    END IF;

    v_filter := lower(coalesce(p_filter, 'all'));

    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_items
    FROM (
        SELECT
            tr.transfer_id, tr.transfer_type, tr.status,
            tr.from_society, tr.from_tower, tr.from_flat_number, tr.from_society_user,
            tr.to_society, tr.to_tower, tr.to_flat_number, tr.to_society_user,
            tr.remaining_validity_days, tr.requested_at, tr.expires_at,
            tr.accepted_at, tr.cancelled_at, tr.completed_at
        FROM "SSP_Subscription_Transfer" tr
        WHERE (
            (v_filter = 'incoming' AND tr.to_society_user = p_user_id)
            OR (v_filter = 'outgoing' AND tr.from_society_user = p_user_id)
            OR (v_filter = 'all' AND (tr.to_society_user = p_user_id OR tr.from_society_user = p_user_id))
        )
        ORDER BY tr.requested_at DESC
        LIMIT 100
    ) t;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', TRUE,          -- ← this was missing
        'items', v_items,
        'filter', v_filter
    );
END;
$function$
